applied.quote:
Four specific types of HRAs are permitted to operate alongside an active HSA under IRS rules:

* A limited-purpose HRA that pays or reimburses only dental, vision, or preventive care expenses.
* A suspended HRA where you formally elect to pause reimbursements before the coverage period begins.
* A post-deductible HRA that pays or reimburses qualified expenses only after you satisfy the minimum annual HDHP deductible.
* A retiree-only HRA that provides reimbursements exclusively after you retire from the employer.
applied.replacement: Four specific types of HRAs are permitted to operate alongside an active HSA under IRS rules: limited-purpose, suspended, post-deductible, and retiree-only HRAs.
